name: XUruguay
description: Gaming retailer in Uruguay with an online store on the Fenicio platform and a store in Montevideo. Sells PlayStation, Nintendo and Xbox consoles, board and card games, figures and PC accessories. States shipping across the whole country in up to 72 business hours.
description_es: Comercio de gaming en Uruguay con tienda online sobre la plataforma Fenicio y un local en Montevideo. Vende consolas PlayStation, Nintendo y Xbox, juegos de mesa y cartas, figuras y accesorios para PC. Indica envíos a todo el país en hasta 72 horas hábiles.

ships_to.notes: Shipping badge states nationwide delivery in up to 72 business hours. Cost not stated.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Store at 18 de Julio 907, Montevideo; store locator linked.
